title: Of Light and Heat Obstructa II
description: Of Light and Heat Obstructa II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Taxman Jones

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill 3 Ice Mutant Unipsycho Leaders and 3 Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders in Lower Frump's Misfortune and Return to Taxman Jones in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Taxman Jones

Repeatable: No

Zone: Frump's Misfortune (quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 3 Ice Mutant Unipsycho Leaders and 3 Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders in Lower Frump's Misfortune and Return to Taxman Jones in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Offer:

Time to take it to the executives, Dungeon Runner. We need results now and I figure the best way to do that is to start rolling the heads of The Frump's executive creatures. He is sure to take notice when he does a spot inspection of the dungeon and all the Ice Mutant Unipsycho and Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders are lying in pools of their own loot.

The main areas of Lower Frump's Misfortune is where you will find the Ice Mutant Unipsycho and Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders and I expect you to 'fire' them on sight. Don't dilly-dally, or pass the buck to another Dungeon Runner, I want you to get your hands dirty for a change. I, Taxman Jones, will be waiting for you here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort so come talk to me when you are done with this task.

Turn-in:

I know it wasn't easy, but hopefully it was fun! I'll make a taxman out of you yet, just you wait. Talk to me when you want to get more training in being someone that no one likes.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Mutant Unipsycho Leaders
  • Slain Shadow Fade Banshee Leaders

Level range: 35–45
